title: Pokemon Diamond and Pearl - Credits
description:
This wallpaper is Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Ending/Credits. The trainer is riding their bike just like in the game's end credits.

This wallpaper features a day/night cycle, with some Pokémon flying on screen. (Wingull, Drifloon, and Magnezone.)

This wallpaper has some customizability which allows you to swap between the boy and girl trainer, change the time of day, toggleable clock and date, and a DS screen filter.

This wallpaper is designed with 1920x1080 resolution and 16:9 ratio in mind.

Sprites ripped from Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum and taken from The Spriter’s Resource.

Music - Credits
Composer - Go Ichinose
